title: Failed MCP tool returns an error result with a secret
reason_not_testable: MCP server name, tool name and error-result shape are UNVERIFIED in the spec, and PostToolUseFailure cannot rewrite output. A fixture would need a fake MCP server whose error shape is measured first. Non-hook control: avoid sending or receiving secrets through MCP tools; PreToolUse guard on MCP inputs is a design option, not yet verified.
